_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-07 (grid drawn over the PNG at 10-12x - lines land exactly on tile edges; 288x464 / 16 = 18x29 = 522 frames, no remainder). Snow pack OBJECT sheet (the terrain counterpart is snow-autotile). No autotile sets on this sheet - everything is a named region. ROW-BAND TRIAGE: rows 0-9 exterior structures - a snow-covered stone enclosure, a cave mouth in rock, a stone wall, and a large snow-roofed log cabin beside snow-drift fill; row 10 is an empty gutter; rows 11-17 a snowy pine and a snowy round tree, flower clusters and sprigs, a snowman, snowballs, stakes, branches, a wheel, plus wooden fences and a gate; rows 17-28 a CABIN INTERIOR set - dark windows, wooden windows, log and brick walls, a ladder, stove pipe, table, cookware, dish shelf, chairs and stools, chests, red and green carpets, beds, food and candles.
